name: BTC vs ETH: Volatility Compression Analysis
description: Cross-asset rolling 30-day realized volatility comparison between Bitcoin and Ethereum, with emphasis on vol compression heading into 2026. Analyzes Yang-Zhang annualized vol for both assets, BTC/ETH vol ratio, and compression signals (current vol vs 90-day trailing average). Dashboard: rolling vol time series, per-asset vol vs its 90d SMA, BTC/ETH vol ratio with 1.0 reference line, and summary statistics table with latest vol, 90d avg, compression ratio, max/min vol, and vol at start of 2026.
source:
# =============================================================================
# BTC vs ETH: VOLATILITY COMPRESSION ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================
# Focused on rolling 30-day realized volatility comparison with emphasis on
# vol compression heading into 2026.
#
# Metrics:
#   1. Rolling 30-day annualized volatility (Yang-Zhang estimator)
#   2. Vol ratio: BTC vol / ETH vol over time
#   3. Compression: current 30d vol vs its own 90-day SMA
#
# Assets: BTCUSD, ETHUSD
# Timeframe: Daily
# =============================================================================

# --- Data Sources ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# --- ETH Reference Data (for BTC/ETH vol ratio) ---
eth_ref = crypto_pairs(ticker="ETHUSD")()

# --- Rolling 30-Day Annualized Volatility (Yang-Zhang) ---
vol_30d = volatility_estimator(type=VolatilityEstimatorType.yang_zhang, period=30)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c)

# ETH vol from reference source (same estimator)
eth_vol_ref = volatility_estimator(type=VolatilityEstimatorType.yang_zhang, period=30)(eth_ref.o, eth_ref.h, eth_ref.l, eth_ref.c)

# --- 90-Day SMA of Rolling Vol (for compression detection) ---
vol_90d_avg = ma(period=90, type=MAType.sma)(vol_30d)

# --- Compression Ratio: current 30d vol / 90d avg vol ---
# Below 1.0 = vol compression (current vol below trailing average)
compression_ratio = vol_30d / vol_90d_avg

# --- BTC/ETH Vol Ratio ---
# Only meaningful on BTC asset; null on ETH to show a single ratio line
is_btc = is_asset_ref(ticker="BTCUSD")()
vol_ratio_raw = vol_30d / eth_vol_ref
vol_ratio = where(is_btc, vol_ratio_raw)

# --- Max & Min Vol (expanding) ---
max_vol = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Max)(vol_30d)
min_vol = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Min)(vol_30d)

# --- Vol at Start of 2026 ---
# Capture first valid vol reading in Jan 2026: Jan 2 or first trading day
bar_ts = index()

# --- Timestamps for chart x-axis ---

# =============================================================================
# REPORTERS (3 charts + 1 table)
# =============================================================================

# 1. Rolling 30-Day Annualized Volatility — BTC vs ETH
cs_lines(
    title='Rolling 30-Day Annualized Vol: BTC vs ETH',
    category='Volatility Comparison',
    y_axis_label='Annualized Volatility',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    order=1
)(bar_ts, vol_30d)

# 2. Per-asset: Rolling 30d Vol vs 90-Day SMA (compression visual)
xy_lines(
    title='30-Day Vol vs 90-Day Average (Compression)',
    category='Volatility Comparison',
    y_axis_label='Annualized Volatility',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='30-Day Vol', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='90-Day Avg', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=2
)(bar_ts, vol_30d, vol_90d_avg)

# 3. BTC/ETH Vol Ratio over time — reference line at 1.0
#    Uses xy_lines (per-asset) since cs_lines doesn't support reference_lines.
#    Only BTC will show a line (ETH is null via is_asset_ref filter).
xy_lines(
    title='BTC / ETH Volatility Ratio',
    category='Vol Ratio',
    y_axis_label='Ratio',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='BTC/ETH Vol Ratio', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=1.0, title='Parity', color=Color.Muted, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=3
)(bar_ts, vol_ratio)

# 4. Summary Statistics Table
cs_summary_table(
    title='Volatility Summary Statistics',
    category='Vol Summary',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    order=4,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='30-Day Vol (Latest)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='90-Day Avg Vol', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Compression (Vol/Avg)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title='Max Vol', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Min Vol', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(vol_30d, vol_90d_avg, compression_ratio, max_vol, min_vol)
